item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 47

  • Favorites and albums are saved with your pictures, so they can come across on a new computer
  • Sort by date, name, or place
  • Add several photos to an album, and rename it
  • Pick and reject photos, and show only picks or rejects
  • Choose an album cover
